CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation bound to the same content/time with literal evidence in this unit.

COD.rationale: Identified content, organization and status features appear in the report but not explicitly bound to the same referent/attribute/time with matching evidence (different n indices).

A.rationale: Processing/attention-style origin labels (e.g. inherited_current, feedback_through) appear elsewhere in the text but no explicit attention/allocation relation is bound to the same content evidence included here.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies content coordinates (color-labeled points) for named referents (e.g. p0/current/n0/red).

D.rationale: The report separately records an origin/status field distinct from the content coordinates for the same referent (origin vs red/blue), distinguishing identification and status.

O.rationale: The report presents organized coordinate patterns for identified content (a full-grid listing for p0/current/n1/red), describing how content is represented across a structure.
